tasks.title: Lecture #81
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in a literature class.
tasks.transcript:
Magical realism is a style of fiction that combines realistic narrative with surreal elements of magic and fantasy. Unlike pure fantasy, magical realism is set in a realistic world. But extraordinary events occur without explanation, blending the ordinary with the extraordinary.
One of the most famous examples of magical realism is Gabrielle Garcia Marquez's novel One Hundred Years of solitude. In this book, everyday life in the fictional town of Macondo is interwoven with fantastic occurrences, such as a character ascending to the heavens while hanging out laundry. These magical events are presented in a matter of fact manner like, this is the way things should be. And this is a hallmark of the genre.
Magical realism often serves to highlight complex social and cultural issues, offering a unique way to explore themes like identity, history and politics. The blending of reality and magic allows authors to delve into deeper truths and challenge readers perceptions of the world. Next, we will examine how magical realism has influenced other literary traditions and its role in contemporary literature.

questions.stem: What is the talk mainly about?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：这段谈话主要关于什么？ 定位原文：Magical realism is a style of fiction that combines realistic narrative with surreal elements of magic and fantasy. （全文围绕 magical realism 的定义、特征、代表作品及其作用展开） 选项分析： A. A famous author 一位著名作家。谈话中提到 Gabriel García Márquez 作为例子，但不是主要内容，所以A选项错误。 B. A literary genre 一种文学体裁。谈话主要介绍 magical realism 这种文学体裁，所以B选项正确。 C. A social influence on fiction 对小说的社会影响。谈话中提到 magical realism 用来探讨社会文化问题，但这不是主要内容，所以C选项错误。 D. An extraordinary event 一个非凡的事件。谈话中提到了非凡事件作为例子，但不是主要内容，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: Why does the speaker discuss what happened to a character in a novel?

options.A: To illustrate how ordinary and magical events are combined in the novel
options.B: To identify the most famous event in the novel
options.C: To highlight the complex social issues discussed in the novel
options.D: To remind listeners that Macondo is a fictional town in the novel

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：说话者为什么讨论小说中一个角色发生的事情？ 定位原文：One of the most famous examples of magical realism is Gabriel García Márquez‘s novel One Hundred Years of Solitude. In this book, everyday life... is interwoven with fantastic occurrences, such as a character ascending to the heavens while hanging out laundry. 选项分析： A. To illustrate how ordinary and magical events are combined in the novel 举例说明小说中普通事件和神奇事件是如何结合的。说话者用这个例子展示现实与魔幻交织的特点，所以A选项正确。 B. To identify the most famous event in the novel 指出小说中最著名的事件。谈话中未说这是最著名的事件，所以B选项错误。 C. To highlight the complex social issues discussed in the novel 强调小说中讨论的复杂社会问题。这个例子本身没有直接说明社会问题，所以C选项错误。 D. To remind listeners that Macondo is a fictional town in the novel 提醒听众马孔多是一个虚构的小镇。这个例子不是为了说明马孔多是虚构的，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what is a hallmark of magical realism?

options.A: Explaining why it is possible for a magical event to occur
options.B: Describing fantastical events as if they were normal
options.C: Presenting events in an extremely complex way
options.D: Changing the order of historical events

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：根据说话者，魔幻现实主义的一个标志是什么？ 定位原文：These magical events are presented in a matter of fact manner as if this is the way things should be. And this is a hallmark of the genre. 选项分析： A. Explaining why it is possible for a magical event to occur 解释神奇事件为何可能发生。魔幻现实主义不解释，而是平实地呈现，所以A选项错误。 B. Describing fantastical events as if they were normal 将奇幻事件描述得像正常事件一样。说话者说“presented in a matter of fact manner as if this is the way things should be”，所以B选项正确。 C. Presenting events in an extremely complex way 以极其复杂的方式呈现事件。谈话中未提及复杂呈现，所以C选项错误。 D. Changing the order of historical events 改变历史事件的顺序。谈话中未提及，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What does the speaker imply is a goal of authors like Gabriel García Márquez?

options.A: Examining how realism has influenced other literary styles
options.B: Challenging readers' understanding of the world

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者暗示像加西亚·马尔克斯这样的作者的一个目标是什么？ 定位原文：The blending of reality and magic allows authors to delve into deeper truths and challenge readers‘ perceptions of the world. 选项分析： A. Examining how realism has influenced other literary styles 审视现实主义如何影响其他文学风格。谈话中未提及，所以A选项错误。 B. Challenging readers’ understanding of the world 挑战读者对世界的理解。说话者明确说“challenge readers‘ perceptions of the world”，所以B选项正确。 C. Presenting diverse political opinions 呈现多样的政治观点。谈话中提到探讨政治等主题，但不是暗示的主要目标，所以C选项不够准确。 D. Making contemporary literature more traditional 使当代文学更加传统。谈话中未提及，且魔幻现实主义并非使文学更传统，所以D选项错误。
